$monsterHealthNote: Health engine rules absent from the Excel tables, plus the monumod.txt row ids whose Constants column carries the minion/champion/unique HP bonus (three consecutive rows each: normal, nightmare, hell). See docs/HEALTH-CALCULATOR.md.
$attackSpeedNote: Engine timing rules; mod weapon/animation values and buff curves are read from source files. curveLevels is how many skill levels each exported speed curve is solved for. See docs/IAS-CALCULATOR.md.
$dropRuneTypesNote: itemtypes.txt codes selecting the drop calculator's rune items (the rune search): every misc.txt base whose Type is a listed code, directly or through its Equiv1/Equiv2 chain, is exported with Kind 'rune'.
$dropMonsterLevelBonusesNote: Engine bonus added to a monster's level when it spawns as this kind; the drop treasure-class level is the base level plus this bonus. Kinds absent here (normal, quest, boss) get 0. The superunique bonus is not applied to boss classes.
$dropGeneratedTreasureClassLevelStepNote: Width of the quality-level bands the game uses for the auto-generated equipment treasure classes (e.g. armo3, armo6, ...), built from itemtypes.txt rows with TreasureClass = 1.
$dropItemRatioVersionNote: itemratio.txt Version value exported (1 = the expansion rows).
$dropMiscCodesNote: Miscellaneous drop search: individual crafting orbs, keys, and worldstone shards. Includes scripted-only items so unavailable monster drops are not invented. Stack containers and grabbers are excluded.
$dropMonsterAreasNote: Fixed boss monstats IDs mapped to levels.txt IDs; their monster levels still come from monstats. See docs/DROP-CALCULATOR.md.
$dropSuperUniqueAreasNote: Fixed map placements absent from levels.txt monster pools. Superunique internal keys map to level IDs; see docs/DROP-CALCULATOR.md for sources. Mod-specific dedicated monsters otherwise use their own spawn pools.
$comment: Configuration for d2r-multi-export export pipeline. Edit these instead of modifying code.
$ignoredUniqueItemsNote: Case-insensitive substrings. UniqueImporter matches them against the uniqueitems.txt index (e.g. 'KhalimFlail'); base armors.json/weapons.json rows match them against the resolved English base name (e.g. "Khalim's Flail"). Quest/spawnable columns are deliberately not consulted.
$skippedCubeRecipesNote: Mirrors doc-generator's hardcoded cube skip rules. Use 'value' for exact match, or 'valueMin'/'valueMax' (inclusive) for ranges.
$ignoredPropertyCodesNote: Property codes silently dropped from the export (formerly hardcoded in PropertyMapper).
$magicNameOverridesNote: Base item NameStr → magic-quality name key (e.g. 'aqv' Arrows → 'z01' Magic Arrows).
$validRequiredClassNamesNote: English class names accepted as RequiredClass when resolved from Equiv2. Treated as a literal pass-through into KeyedEquipment.RequiredClass on the wire.
$skillTreeCategoryKeysNote: Localized tree title keys in skilldesc.txt SkillPage order for each skills.txt charclass code.
$skillDescriptionMaxLevelNote: Highest effective skill level (hard points plus +skills) the exported per-level description tables are solved to. The bonus-level axis of a values2d grid runs 0..(this - maxlvl).
$skillDescriptionCharacterLevelsNote: Highest character level (ulvl) the exported valuesUlvl tables are solved to. Only lines whose formula actually reads ulvl carry that axis.
$skillDescriptionDifficultyNote: Which branch of cond('Difficulty', normal|nightmare|hell) the description tables are solved for. The website shows end-game numbers, so hell.
$calcFormulaOverridesNote: skillcalc.txt/misscalc.txt print the diminishing-returns codes as one combined division, which describes the result rather than the arithmetic the engine performs: the game truncates the inner percentage first, as (110*lvl)/(lvl+6), and only then applies it to (max-min). Verified against vanilla Fanaticism's published table (14 18 20 23 25 26 27 28 29 30 31 31 32 33 33 34 34 34 34 35 for levels 1-20), which the combined form misses at levels 3 and 12. No clamp at max: the mod's own hand-written Berserk cell spells the same two-step form out and adds an explicit min() cap, which would be redundant if dm* clamped. Only codes the reference table already defines as formulas are replaced, so a mod shipping its own copy of the table still gets the correction.
$skippedAutoMagicGroupsNote: AutoMagic.txt group ids skipped wholesale during keyed export.
$propertyPostCalcFilteredCodesNote: Stat codes stripped from the property list AFTER DamageArmorCalculator has consumed them (formerly hardcoded in PropertyMapper.PostCalcFilter).
$propertyStatOverridesNote: Stat-name remapping for property codes whose Properties.txt entry doesn't list a stat or lists the wrong one (formerly hardcoded in PropertyMapper.StatOverrides).
$propertyPriorityOverridesNote: Display-priority overrides for property codes whose stat has no descpriority in ItemStatCost (formerly hardcoded in PropertyMapper.PriorityOverrides).
$customSkillTabAliasesNote: Mod-added property codes that act as a class-restricted random skill tab (`+N Random Skill Tab (<Class> Only)`) but have no row in `properties.txt`. Maps the property code to a 3-letter CharStats class code; the resolver routes it through the same path as `tab-rand` with the class fixed. Mirrors the doc-generator's hardcoded Wraithstep workaround.
$propertyElementalExpansionsNote: Multi-stat elemental properties expanded into separate min/max/len entries so MergeElementalTriplets can aggregate them (formerly hardcoded in PropertyMapper.ElementalExpansions).
$propertyCodeExpansionsNote: Unique-item property codes that stand for several other property codes, each mapped with the original param/min/max (formerly hardcoded in UniqueImporter.MapProperties). `dmg-elem` is the all-elements damage shorthand.
$damageArmorEnhancedCodesNote: Property codes whose presence sets the exported DamageArmorEnhanced flag on uniques and sets (formerly hardcoded in UniqueImporter / SetImporter).
$requirementPercentCodesNote: Property codes (item_req_percent) that scale an item's Str/Dex requirements; RequirementHelper.ApplyEaseAdjustment applies them (formerly hardcoded as `ease` in the Unique/Set/Runeword importers).
$elementalDamagePairsNote: Elemental min/max pairings used by PropertyCleanup.MergeElementalTriplets (formerly hardcoded in PropertyCleanup.ElementalPairs). The element label is raw English used only as an internal discriminator, not on the wire.
$splitElementalCodesNote: Min/max/len elemental damage codes that ItemStatCost typically renders as bare numbers (formerly hardcoded in PropertyCleanup.SplitElementalCodes). Must survive UniqueImporter's bare-int filter so MergeElementalTriplets can aggregate them.
$propertyMergeBlocklistNote: Property codes that must NOT be merged across rows even when their (PropertyCode, Parameter) match (formerly hardcoded as `neverMerge` inside PropertyCleanup.CleanupDuplicates). `rip`/`randclassskill`/`skill-rand` carry distinct random-skill pools; `dmg%` is intentionally additive across multiple rolls.
$cubeGrabberSentinelsNote: Early-stop sentinel codes for CubeMain.txt (formerly hardcoded in CubeRecipeImporter.GrabberSentinels). Once Input1 and Output both fall in this set the importer enters skip-but-continue mode.
$cubeSocketPunchNote: Post-sentinel allow-list for the socket-punch carve-out (formerly hardcoded in CubeRecipeImporter.SocketPunchEquipTokens / SocketPunchJewelQualities). Helm/Torso/Shield/Weapon + jewel × {mag|rar|uni} → useitem with Mod1 = sock.
$cubeIngredientLabelsNote: Raw English labels for cube ingredient/output qualifier tokens (formerly hardcoded in CubeRecipeImporter.InputDisplay / OutputDisplay). AGENTS.md documented exception #1 (cube recipe content ships raw English by design); only the storage location is JSON. Editing these does NOT need a code change.
$itemTypeIndexAliasesNote: itemtypes.txt codes whose exported Index (and therefore translation key) is redirected onto another item type's key instead of the default `${code}itype`. `h2h2` is the duplicate hand-to-hand bucket collapsed onto the canonical `h2hitype` so exports never carry a separate h2h2itype key (formerly hardcoded in DataLoader.LoadItemTypesAsync).
$skillIconSheetsNote: skills.txt charclass code -> the HD skill-icon sprite sheet under hd/global/ui/spells/<folder>/<file>. SkillIconExporter cuts each skilldesc IconCel frame out of the sheet into sprites/skills/<class>-<cel>.webp. A class missing here exports no icons and is reported (formerly hardcoded in SkillIconExporter.Sheets).
$itemStatCompositeKeysNote: Composite damage lines the save viewer renders from a min/max stat pair, mapped to the translation key of the combined range line. Written verbatim to keyed/item-stat-presentation.json -> CompositeKeys (formerly hardcoded in ItemStatPresentationExporter.CompositeKeys). Every value must resolve in strings/<lang>.json.
